                        format-patch body); the checks compare it against
                        --repo as it stands, so --repo must be a checkout of
                        the diff's BASE, not a tree with the diff already
                        applied
  --path REL            a file in --repo whose proposed whole new text is in
                        --after (the per-edit hook form). Runs
                        complexity_delta and contract_drift, which read only
                        this file. --only can add clone_delta, which reads the
                        clone blocks of every tier-1 source file from the tag
                        cache only, and gives one not_checked row when there
                        is no cache
  --since REV           compare each file changed since the commit REV with
                        its working-tree text (review mode). Runs
                        complexity_delta and contract_drift, which read only
                        the changed files. --only can add clone_delta, which
                        also reads every tier-1 source file. For a branch,
                        pass --since "$(git merge-base HEAD main)"
  --after FILE          the file that holds the proposed whole new text of
                        --path
  --only CHECK[,CHECK...]

                        near_duplicates, dangling_references,
                        dangling_callers, arity, cycle_delta,
                        complexity_delta, contract_drift, clone_delta. The
                        pair checks (complexity_delta, contract_drift,
                        clone_delta) compare whole file texts.

                        edited files. clone_delta also reads every tier-1
                        source file outside test and fixture paths. A run with
                        only pair checks skips the symbol scan that the other
                        checks need

                        0 on a run that happened

    map                 ranked, token-budgeted repository map
    tree                gitignore-aware directory tree
    skeleton            signatures with bodies elided
    expand              full bodies for named stable ids
    slice               numbered lines with scope headers
    find-symbol         substring or qualified symbol lookup
    refs                fan-in: what references this symbol
    history             why does this code exist: the commits that touched a
                        symbol's lines
    explain             one symbol card: definition, fan-out, fan-in
    path                shortest resolved path between two symbols
    cycles              module-level import cycles
    communities         which files belong together
    diagram             mermaid flowchart of the module graph
    health              orphan candidates, unused exports, hubs and complexity
                        hotspots
    html                interactive HTML export of the module graph
    resolve-locs        turn class:/function:/line: strings into intervals
    patch               SEARCH/REPLACE patch machinery (write side)
    lint                deterministic hallucination checks over candidate
                        patches (write side)
    validate            run candidate patches against the tests
    vote                rank validated candidates by equivalence cluster
    warmup              fetch and probe grammars; fails loudly
    index               build or refresh the tag cache
    capabilities        grammars, versions and caps in force
    guide               print the packaged agent usage guide

options:

  --token-counter {chars4,tiktoken}
